qt: to the Commission Ciaran Mullooly (Renew) Subject:

Regulation (EU) 2025/26501 amended Article 34 of Regulation (EU) 2023/11152 (the EU Deforestation Regulation), extending the deadline for the Commission’s general review from 30 June 2028 to 30 June 2030. The requirement to assess the impact on farmers, particularly smallholders, Indigenous Peoples and local communities, is now contained in Article 34(2)(b) of the EU Deforestation Regulation. Can the Commission clarify: 1.
What methodology and timetable will be used to assess the regulation’s impact on farmers, particularly smallholders, Indigenous Peoples and local communities?
What information will Member States be required to provide, and by what deadlines?
Will the Commission publish the evidence received and consult directly with farming organisations before completing its review?
